name: 2020-1c-parcial2-tema2
title: Warehouse robots – packing trailers and product shipping (Tema 2)
description: Starting from the first-midterm warehouse model (robots, products, trailers, cashier), the student must add smart trailers with pluggable packers (bubble wrap adding 4 protection points, made-to-measure carton box adding 75% but skipping type B products) without modifying the Trailer class, and model shipping a robot's trailer through a distribution center that picks a cargo vehicle by destination, arrival time (via a simulated external travel-time service) and weight capacity, using a configurable selection criterion (heaviest vehicle or first to arrive).

design.notes: Mirror image of Tema 1: Trailer cannot be modified so packers need a decorator or wrapper plus double dispatch on the product kind, the selection criterion must be a swappable strategy object, and the vehicle choice is a select:/detect:/inject: pipeline over heterogeneous vehicles whose travel times come from a simulated external service.
